content.text: Skip to content Creighton University Omaha, Nebraska (402) 280-2700 Visit Website Located in the center of America’s heartland (and founded in 1878), Creighton University is rooted in Catholic, Jesuit traditions and offers more than 7,000 students a contemporary, relevant education through its nine schools and colleges. A Creighton education, which bridges liberal arts, graduate and professional education in an environment of shared Jesuit values, is based on academic excellence, social justice and personal growth. We approach education with a passion for learning and a zeal for helping students of all faiths discover who they are and how they can make a difference in the world. Our Jesuit vision commits us to form women and men of competence, conscience and compassion, enlivened with a faith that does justice.
